# Setup
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ape)
  library(caper)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(future)
  library(furrr)
})

# Get dataset (QE, Body Weight, P50...)

base_path <- "//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/gianl/piezo1_pipeline/data_analysis"

# Main dataset
combined_dt <- read.csv(file.path(base_path, "main_dataset.csv"))

# QE regions (long format)
dt_QE_all <- bind_rows(
 read_tsv(file.path(base_path, "PGLS_data/primates_QE_regions_290426.tsv"), 
          show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(order = "Primates"),
 read_tsv(file.path(base_path, "PGLS_data/carnivora_QE_regions_290426.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(order = "Carnivora"),
 read_tsv(file.path(base_path, "PGLS_data/rodentia_QE_regions_290426.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(order = "Rodentia"),
 read_tsv(file.path(base_path, "PGLS_data/cetartiodactyla_QE_regions_290426.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(order = "Cetartiodactyla")
)


# Clade mappings
selected_clades <- bind_rows(
 read_tsv(file.path(base_path, "taxonomy_files/primates_species_clade_mapping.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
 read_tsv(file.path(base_path, "taxonomy_files/rodentia_species_clade_mapping.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
 read_tsv(file.path(base_path, "taxonomy_files/carnivora_species_clade_mapping_v2.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
 read_tsv(file.path(base_path, "taxonomy_files/cetartiodactyla_species_clade_mapping.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
)

# Plotting data
plot_data <- dt_QE_all %>%
 inner_join(combined_dt %>% dplyr::select(species, log10_body_mass_g, DPG_factor), by = "species") %>%
 inner_join(selected_clades, by = "species")

```

# Prepare phylogenetic tree and data for caper PGLS
```{r}
# Phylogenetic tree
phy_tree <- read.tree(file.path(base_path, "PGLS_data/phylo_trees/all_species_timetree.nwk"))

# Comparative data object
comp_tree_data <- comparative.data(
 data = combined_dt,
 phy = phy_tree,
 names.col = "species",
 na.omit = FALSE
)

print(comp_tree_data)
```

```{r}
# Generate all models
# If something goes wrong it is in this table

model_config <- tribble(
 ~model_id, ~response_var,           ~metric,    ~region,
 1,         "QE_sum_QE_region_1",    "QE_sum",   "QE_region_1",
 2,         "QE_sum_QE_region_2",    "QE_sum",   "QE_region_2",
 3,         "QE_sum_QE_region_3",    "QE_sum",   "QE_region_3",
 4,         "E_count_QE_region_1",   "E_count",  "QE_region_1",
 5,         "E_count_QE_region_2",   "E_count",  "QE_region_2",
 6,         "E_count_QE_region_3",   "E_count",  "QE_region_3",
 7,         "E_ratio_QE_region_1",   "E_ratio",  "QE_region_1",
 8,         "E_ratio_QE_region_2",   "E_ratio",  "QE_region_2",
 9,         "E_ratio_QE_region_3",   "E_ratio",  "QE_region_3",
 10,        "Neg_charge_QE_region_1","Neg_charge","QE_region_1",
 11,        "Neg_charge_QE_region_2","Neg_charge","QE_region_2",
 12,        "Neg_charge_QE_region_3","Neg_charge","QE_region_3",
 13,        "Net_charge_QE_region_1","Net_charge","QE_region_1",
 14,        "Net_charge_QE_region_2","Net_charge","QE_region_2",
 15,        "Net_charge_QE_region_3","Net_charge","QE_region_3",
 16,        "Net_charge_no_H_QE_region_1","Net_charge_no_H","QE_region_1",
 17,        "Net_charge_no_H_QE_region_2","Net_charge_no_H","QE_region_2",
 18,        "Net_charge_no_H_QE_region_3","Net_charge_no_H","QE_region_3",
 19,        "QE_sum_total",          "QE_total", "total",
 20,        "E_sum_total",           "E_total",  "total"
)

print(model_config)

# Fit all determined models


fit_pgls_model <- function(response_var, data) {
 formula <- as.formula(paste(response_var, "~ log10_body_mass_g"))
 pgls(formula, data = data, lambda = "ML")
}

# Fit all models and store in a named list
models <- model_config %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(model = list(fit_pgls_model(response_var, comp_tree_data))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(model_id, metric, region, model)

# Create named list for easy access: models_list$QE_sum$QE_region_1
models_list <- models %>%
 group_by(metric) %>%
 group_split() %>%
 set_names(map_chr(., ~.x$metric[1])) %>%
 map(~set_names(.x$model, .x$region))

# Show results

models %>%
 mutate(
   intercept = map_dbl(model, ~coef(.x)[1]),
   slope = map_dbl(model, ~coef(.x)[2]),
   lambda = map_dbl(model, ~.x$param["lambda"]),
   p_value = map_dbl(model, ~summary(.x)$coefficients[2, 4])
 ) %>%
 select(-model) %>%
 print(n = 11)
```

# Model diagnostics
```{r}
# Diagnostics function for single PGLS model

pgls_diagnostics <- function(mod, label = "", save_dir = NULL, n_predictors = 1) {
  
  t_start <- Sys.time()
  message("[", format(t_start, "%H:%M:%S"), "] Starting: ", label)
  
  res <- residuals(mod, phylo = TRUE)
  fit <- fitted(mod)
  dat <- mod$data$data
  
  order_group <- dat$order
  
  order_colour <- c("Primates" = "darkred",
                    "Rodentia" = "steelblue",
                    "Carnivora" = "darkorange",
                    "Cetartiodactyla" = "forestgreen"
                    
    
  )
  
  full_lambda <- unname(mod$param["lambda"])
  
  if (!is.null(save_dir)){
    png(file.path(save_dir, paste0("diag_", label, ".png")), 
        width = 11, height = 9, units = "in", res = 600)
  }
  
  par(mfrow = c(2,3), oma = c(0,0,2,0), mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 3, 1))
  
   ## QQ plot (normality of residuals)
  qqnorm(res, main = "Normal Q-Q", 
         pch = 19,col = "steelblue",
         xlab = "Theoretical quantiles",
         ylab = "Phylogenetic residuals")
  qqline(res, col = "firebrick", lwd = 2)
  
  ## Residuals vs fitted (homogeneity of variation)
  plot(fit, res,
       xlab = "Fitted values", 
       ylab = "Phylogenetic residuals",
       main = "Residuals vs Fitted", 
       pch = 19, col = order_colour[as.character(order_group)])
  abline(h = 0, 
         lty = 2, 
         col = "grey50")
  
  # Residual variance by order
  
  boxplot(res ~ order_group,
          main = "Residual variance by order",
          xlab = "Order", ylab = "Phylogenetic residuals",
          col = order_colour[levels(factor(order_group))],
          las = 2, cex.axis = 0.8)
  abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey50")
  
  ## Influence of particular data (LOO)
  phy <- mod$data$phy
  form <- formula(mod)
  
  loo_slopes <- future_map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(dat)), function(i) {
    dat_i <- dat[-i, , drop = FALSE]
    dat_i$species <- rownames(dat_i)
    cd_i <- tryCatch(
      comparative.data(phy = phy, data = dat_i, names.col = "species",
                       na.omit = FALSE, warn.dropped = FALSE),
       error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(cd_i)) return(NA)
    m_i <- tryCatch(
      pgls(form, data = cd_i, lambda = full_lambda),
      error = function(e) tryCatch(
        pgls(form, data = cd_i, lambda = 1),
        error = function(e2) NULL
      )
    )
    if (is.null(m_i)) return(NA)
    unname(coef(m_i)[2])
  },
  .options = furrr_options(
    packages = "caper",
    globals = c("phy", "form", "dat", "full_lambda")
  ),
  .progress = TRUE
  )
    
    full_slope <- coef(mod)[2]
    full_se <- summary(mod)$coefficients[2,2]
    dfbetas <- (loo_slopes - full_slope) / full_se
    
    plot(seq_along(dfbetas), dfbetas,
         xlab = "Species index",
         ylab = "Standardised slope change (dfbeta)",
         main = "Leave-one-out influence",
         pch = 19, col = order_colour[as.character(order_group)])
    abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey50")
    abline(h = c(-1,1), lty = 3, col = "firebrick")
  
  
  ## Lambda profile
  lam_prof <- tryCatch(
    pgls.profile(mod, which = "lambda"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.null(lam_prof)){
    plot(lam_prof, main = expression(lambda~"likelihood profile"))
  } else {
    plot.new(); title(expression(lambda~"profile unavailable"))
  }
  
  mtext(label, outer = TRUE, cex = 1.3, font = 2)
  par(mfrow = c(1,1))
  
  if (!is.null(save_dir)) dev.off()
  
  t_end <- Sys.time()
  elapsed <- round(as.numeric(difftime(t_end, t_start, units = "secs")), 1)
  message("[", format(t_end, "%H:%M:%S"), "] Finished: ", label, 
          " (", elapsed, "s)")
  
  ## summary table
  invisible(data.frame(
    label = label,
    lambda = round(unname(mod$param["lambda"]), 3),
    slope = round(unname(full_slope), 4),
    slope_p = round(summary(mod)$coefficients[2,4], 4),
    max_abs_dfbeta = round(max(abs(dfbetas), na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    n_influential = sum(abs(dfbetas) > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abs_resid = round(max(abs(res)), 3),
    resid_var_primates       = round(var(res[order_group == "Primates"]), 3),
    resid_var_carnivora      = round(var(res[order_group == "Carnivora"]), 3),
    resid_var_rodentia       = round(var(res[order_group == "Rodentia"]), 3),
    resid_var_cetartiodactyla = round(var(res[order_group == "Cetartiodactyla"]), 3)
  ))
}

# Run diagnostics function

plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)

diag_dir <- file.path(base_path, "plots", "diagnostic_pooled")
dir.create(diag_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

while (!is.null(dev.list())) dev.off()

model_diagnosis <- models %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(metric, "_", region),
    diag = map2(model, label, ~pgls_diagnostics(
      .x, label = .y, save_dir = diag_dir
    ))
  ) %>%
  select(diag) %>%
  unnest(diag)

write.csv(model_diagnosis,
          file.path(diag_dir, "diagnostic_summary_pooled.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

plan(sequential)
```

# Make summary table of models with diagnostics
```{r}

summary_table <- models %>%
  mutate(
    n         = map_int(model, ~ nrow(.x$data$data)),
    lambda    = map_dbl(model, ~ unname(.x$param["lambda"])),
    intercept = map_dbl(model, ~ unname(coef(.x)[1])),
    slope     = map_dbl(model, ~ unname(coef(.x)[2])),
    se        = map_dbl(model, ~ summary(.x)$coefficients[2, 2]),
    p_value   = map_dbl(model, ~ summary(.x)$coefficients[2, 4]),
    r_squared = map_dbl(model, ~ summary(.x)$r.squared),
    ci_lo     = slope - 1.96 * se,
    ci_hi     = slope + 1.96 * se,
  ) %>%
select(metric, region, n, lambda, intercept, slope, se, ci_hi, ci_lo, p_value, r_squared)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    All_metrics = summary_table,
    Diagnostics = model_diagnosis
  ),
  path = file.path(base_path, "PGLS_summary_tables", "pooled_PGLS_all_results.xlsx")
)
```

# Plotting models
```{r}
# Confidence band calculation, also for interaction models
compute_pgls_band <- function(mod, x_range, interaction_var, interaction_level) {
 b <- coef(mod)
 fit <- b[1] + b[2] * x_range
 
 X_pred <- cbind(1, x_range)
 X <- mod$x
 Vt <- mod$Vt
 RMS <- mod$RMS[1, 1]
 
 V_inv <- solve(Vt)
 XtVinvX_inv <- solve(t(X) %*% V_inv %*% X)
 vcov_beta <- RMS * XtVinvX_inv
 
 var_fit <- rowSums((X_pred %*% vcov_beta) * X_pred)
 se_fit <- sqrt(var_fit)
 
 data.frame(
   log10_body_mass_g = x_range,
   fit = fit,
   lwr = fit - 1.96 * se_fit,
   upr = fit + 1.96 * se_fit
 )
}

# GENERATE BANDS AND LABELS FOR ALL MODELS

x_data <- plot_data %>%
 distinct(species, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
 filter(!is.na(log10_body_mass_g)) %>%
 pull(log10_body_mass_g)

x_range <- seq(min(x_data), max(x_data), length.out = 100)

# Generate bands for all models
all_bands <- models %>%
 mutate(
   band = map(model, ~compute_pgls_band(.x, x_range))
 ) %>%
 select(metric, region, band) %>%
 unnest(band)

# Generate labels for all models
all_labels <- models %>%
 mutate(
   lambda = map_dbl(model, ~.x$param["lambda"]),
   p_value = map_dbl(model, ~summary(.x)$coefficients[2, 4]),
   label = sprintf("λ = %.2f, p = %.3f", lambda, p_value)
 ) %>%
 select(metric, region, label)

# HELPER FUNCTION FOR PLOTTING

plot_pgls_by_metric <- function(metric_name, y_var, y_label, title) {
 
 # Filter bands and labels for this metric
 bands <- all_bands %>% filter(metric == metric_name)
 labels <- all_labels %>% filter(metric == metric_name)
 
 # Filter plot data to the correct y variable
 plot_df <- plot_data %>%
   rename(y_value = !!sym(y_var))
 
 ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log10_body_mass_g, y = y_value, colour = order)) +
   geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
   geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
   geom_ribbon(data = bands,
               aes(x = log10_body_mass_g, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
               fill = "firebrick", alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
   geom_line(data = bands,
             aes(x = log10_body_mass_g, y = fit),
             color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed",
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +
   geom_text(data = labels,
             aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
             hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 6, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
   facet_wrap(~region, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
   labs(
     x = expression(log[10] ~ body ~ mass ~ (g)),
     y = y_label,
     title = title
   ) +
   theme_classic() +
   theme(
     axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
     axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
     plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
     legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
     legend.title = element_text(size = 16)
   )
}


# Generate plots


plot_path <- file.path(base_path, "plots")

# QE_sum plot
p_QE_sum <- plot_pgls_by_metric(
 metric_name = "QE_sum",
 y_var = "QE_sum",
 y_label = "QE sum",
 title = "Pooled orders: QE sum vs body mass"
)
ggsave("PGLS_pooled_QE_sum.png", 
       p_QE_sum, 
       path = plot_path, 
       width = 10, 
       height = 10, 
       dpi = 600)

# Neg_charge plot
p_Neg_charge <- plot_pgls_by_metric(

)
ggsave("PGLS_pooled_Neg_charge.png",

# Net_charge plot

ggsave("PGLS_pooled_Net_charge.png",
```
